worked_example.problem: After frying plantains, Tabot pours the hot oil down the sink. Why is this a bad idea, and what should Tabot do?
steps: Oil cools and becomes thick in the pipe, so the drain gets blocked.
Let the oil cool, keep it to use again or pour it into a container and throw it away with the rubbish.
worked_example.answer: It blocks the drain; let it cool and put it in a container instead.

cards.idea: Wipe worktops and the cooker after use, sweep and mop the floor, and empty the dustbin often.
example: Crumbs and a full bin attract flies, cockroaches and rats.

cards.idea: Look after equipment: clean the cooker when cool, defrost the fridge, keep fat out of the sink.
example: Fat poured down the sink sets hard and blocks the drain.

cards.idea: Stay safe: switch off appliances after use and check gas taps and pipes for leaks.
example: If you smell gas, open the windows and do not light a match or switch anything on.

check.prompt: You smell gas in the kitchen. What should you do first?

right.text: Open the windows and do not light anything; tell an adult.

wrong.text: Light a match to find the leak.
wrong.explain: A flame can make the gas explode.

wrong.text: Switch on the light to see better.
wrong.explain: A spark from a switch can light the gas.
Fresh air is needed to clear the gas.
Lighting the cooker can make the gas explode.

questions.prompt: Sort these: good care or bad practice in a modern kitchen?

pool.left: switching off the cooker after use
keeping old food in the fridge
cleaning the hot cooker with a wet cloth

pick.why: We wipe the worktops after use to remove germs and food that attract insects.

pick.t: clean spills on the cooker when it is cool
pick.a: so they do not burn on and to avoid burns
pick.why: We clean spills on the cooker when it is cool so they do not burn on and to avoid burns.

pick.a: to stop bad smells, flies and rats
pick.why: We empty the dustbin every day to stop bad smells, flies and rats.

pick.t: defrost and clean the fridge regularly
pick.a: so it works well and food stays safe
pick.why: We defrost and clean the fridge regularly so it works well and food stays safe.
